tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

content.text:
# document level relations:
(d / document
    :temporal ((document-creation-time :before s1d)
               (document-creation-time :overlap s1p)
               (document-creation-time :after s1c4)
               (s1c4 :overlap s1j)
               (document-creation-time :after s1h2)
               (s1h2 :overlap s1i))
    :modal ((root :modal author)
            (author :full-affirmative s1d)
            (author :full-affirmative s1p)
            (author :full-affirmative s1c4)
            (author :full-affirmative s1j)
            (author :full-affirmative s1h2)
            (author :full-affirmative s1i)))

This is sentence 1 of 6, so there is no coreference group. All three mentions of 中国 and both of 日本 are already one node each in the graph. I did not look anything up in PropBank, because no relation here depended on a predicate's exact meaning.

- **Time:**
  - 达成 (reaching the consensus) is a completed past event, so it comes before the document-creation time.
  - 排海 (the discharge) is shown as going on now, overlapping the document-creation time. Nothing in the sentence says this; I am assuming the discharge has already started and is still happening.
  - 参与 (taking part) and 恢复 (resuming) are marked by 将 ("will"), so they come after the document-creation time.
  - 监测 (the monitoring) overlaps the taking part, and 进口 (the imports) overlap the resuming.
- **Modality:** the author states every event with full certainty. 将 counts as a plain "will", which the guidelines treat as full-affirmative.
- **Judgement call on the monitoring and imports:** I attached 监测 and 进口 straight to the author. Another option is to make them depend on 参与 and 恢复. A gold annotation might also treat the future steps as part of the consensus and make that the conceiver, which would change the modal entries.
